artworks.title: Study of "The Roman Orator (Germanicus)"
artworks.medium: graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image shows a simple sketch of a person's upper body on the left side of a blank page. The individual is lying down with their head turned slightly to the side in partial profile. The facial features are depicted with minimal lines, suggesting closed or relaxed eyes and a neutral expression. The hair is drawn lightly, indicating a short style. The person's left arm is bent and raised slightly, with the hand near the face. No clothing, jewelry, or objects are included in the sketch.

artworks.title: Study of the Allegorical Figure Bellona in Rubens' "The Apotheosis of Henri IV"
artworks.medium: graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of a reclining upper body with the torso, part of the legs, and one arm above the head. Facial features are suggested through light lines, and the hair appears styled. The person is unclothed without any visible jewelry or objects. The sketch is on a blank, light-colored page, possibly in a sketchbook, with the figure centered on the left side. The background is minimalistic to highlight the figure.

artworks.title: Studies Including Madame Cezanne
artworks.medium: graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of a baby's head in a sleeping position. The baby has closed eyes, a rounded nose, closed lips, and softly curled hair. There are abstract shapes and lines around the baby suggesting soft textures. The background is formed by the off-white pages of a sketchbook.

artworks.title: Chair and Dresser
artworks.medium: graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a wooden structure with circular elements. The sketch depicts a section of wooden panels or boards, with vertical and horizontal lines suggesting a constructed form. Two circular shapes are incorporated into the design, creating a sense of symmetry. The wood grain is indicated through shading and lines, and there are wavy lines across the shapes. The drawing is incomplete, filling only part of the page, with the top right displaying the number '103'. It is drawn in a sketchbook, as seen by the binding and blank space surrounding the detailed drawing.

artworks.title: Study of "Venus de Milo"
artworks.medium: graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art

artworks.title: Basket
artworks.medium: graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image shows a small sketch of a basket filled with round objects in the upper left corner of the page. The drawing is done with pencil on yellowed paper, with some light smudges and graphite lines present on the rest of the page.

artworks.title: Trees and Shrubs
artworks.medium: graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: This image shows a sketch from a slightly elevated perspective without a horizon line. The upper section features dense, diagonal pencil strokes indicating a shaded area or foliage. Below, lighter, dispersed lines represent leaves or plants in angular and circular forms. The image is monochromatic, created with pencil on paper, emphasizing contrast between light and shadow. The composition conveys movement through varying weights and directions of pencil strokes.

artworks.title: Two Bathers
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on end papers
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch within a notebook. The drawing depicts rough outlines of two human-like figures in informal poses, one seated and one standing with their back turned. The lines are simple and spontaneous, conveying movement and form with minimal detail. The figures are surrounded by handwritten notes in cursive, possibly annotations or reflections related to the drawing. The page has an aged appearance, suggesting use as a sketchbook or journal for recording ideas and observations.

artworks.title: Ploughman in the Fields near Arles
artworks.medium: reed pen and brown ink over graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon
artworks.description: Drawn with brown ink on tan paper, fields stretch away from us toward three farm buildings and a man walking behind a plough pulled by a horse in this horizontal landscape. The grass and plants in the field closest to us are suggested by tightly packed clusters of parallel, short, vertical strokes and curlicues. Just beyond it is a gap, suggesting a road, and another field made up of rows of short strokes angled slight to the left or right that recede toward the man and buildings. Two twisted trees, each with a gnarled trunk and spiky branches, stands to our left and right where the more distant fields meet the road, near the sides of the paper. The trees reach high into the blank sky above them. Farther back and to our left, the man and horse are drawn with only a few strokes each, shown facing our right in profile. Beyond them, vertical lines of varying heights, with some intersected by horizontal lines, separate the field from the farmhouses. We see the top level of the three loosely drawn buildings along the horizon line, which comes just under halfway up the composition. The largest is a long rectangular structure just right of center with a few windows scattered across its facade. To the left, beyond the horse and ploughman, is a smaller square structure with a peaked roof. On the far left, the third building has two dots suggesting windows. More thin, vertical strokes appear beyond the buildings, and a low bank of puffy clouds hovers just above the horizon on the right side. Some outlines in graphite are visible under or near the ink lines.

artworks.title: Harlech Castle and Snowdon
artworks.medium: watercolor over graphite with sponging-out on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape with a castle in a valley. Mountains are in the distance under a soft sky. The castle, stone with cylindrical towers, stands in the middle. There are rooftops indicating a village around it. The painting uses detailed brushstrokes for a realistic effect. The nearby land is brown and green, and foliage is in muted greens and browns. The color scheme is dominated by cool blues and grays, creating a serene atmosphere. Figures with a cart and animals are present in the middle ground.

artworks.title: Milsom Street in Bath
artworks.medium: pen and gray and black ink with gray wash and watercolor over graphite on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts a streetscape with Georgian buildings on the left side. The horizon is low, emphasizing the architecture. The street continues into the horizon with various structures. The brushstrokes are precise, showcasing neoclassical facade details. The color palette consists of earth tones for buildings and soft blues and grays for the sky. Pedestrians walk on the sidewalk, and a horse-drawn carriage moves along the cobblestone street.

artworks.title: Interior of Bushey Church
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink and watercolor over graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: This painting depicts an interior hallway with tall wooden paneling on both sides, leading towards an arched window in the distance. The ceiling is vaulted with curved beams, and there is an elaborate chandelier hanging in the center. The floor is paved with red bricks, and there is a combination of natural and subdued lighting. The style is reminiscent of English architectural depictions from the mid-18th to 19th century.

artworks.title: Scoa Camin (Chimney Sweep)
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a chimney sweep at work. The figure is wearing a hat and coat, leaning forward and holding a large brush over his shoulder. In the background, there is a building that suggests an urban setting. The brush's bristles are detailed, and the image includes architectural details of the surrounding buildings. Another figure is visible on a rooftop in the background. The drawing uses shading and line work to convey texture and depth.

artworks.title: Marcer (Draper)
artworks.medium: engraving and etching on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a person entertaining two dogs while two figures watch from a window. In the image, the main subject is a person standing on the right, dressed in 18th-century clothing, pointing to two small dogs standing on their hind legs. The setting includes a building with a window on the left, where two figures lean out, observing the scene. The drawing is detailed with fine lines and contains an inscription at the bottom.

artworks.title: Fà ballar i Cani (Street Entertainer)
artworks.medium: engraving and etching on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts a group of four people under a decorative archway and next to a column. The man on the far left is leaning on a staff and singing. To his right is a man playing a violin. Beside him is another figure playing a guitar or a lute. Slightly set apart from the group is a younger individual gesturing with one hand held out, holding a hat in the other. The background features a building with small windows, clouds, and a lined sky, capturing an urban street scene.

artworks.title: Seacoast with a Great Tree
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink and touches of gray ink with gray washes on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape with a large tree as the main focus, filling much of the frame vertically. A faint horizon line is visible with distant trees to the right above a strip of land. The brushwork features expressive, linear strokes creating textures within the foliage and ground. The color palette consists of warm brown tones against a muted beige background. In the foreground, the ground gently slopes with small plants, and a subtle waterway flows through the scene.

artworks.title: Ruined Stairs at Neuss
artworks.medium: graphite on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Thomas Le Claire
artworks.description: The image shows a narrow passageway between tall structures. There is no visible horizon, focusing on the vertical space. The scene features stone steps leading up to an arched brickwork. The architectural details are precise with subtle shading, emphasizing texture. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades of grey. A small figure in motion is seen close by with minimal detailing. The image captures an intimate urban setting with light and shadow play in the archway and stairwell.

artworks.title: The Beheading of Saint John the Baptist
artworks.medium: pen and brown and gray ink with red-violet wash, heightened with white, on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of multiple figures in a classical setting. The image depicts characters in historical attire with feathers and armor, showcasing a dynamic scene. One figure is kneeling on the ground and another is reaching towards the person holding a tray. Architectural elements like arches and columns are visible in the background, and the drawing utilizes lines and shading for texture and depth.

artworks.title: Stream through an Ancient Forest
artworks.medium: black chalk heightened with white gouache on brown laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a dense wooded area visible from an elevated perspective. The horizon blends into the foliage and trees. A pathway winds from the foreground into the distance through the trees. The artwork features a mix of swirling lines and detailed patterns created with graphite or ink, giving a textured appearance. Earthy tones like brown and black are prevalent, with white highlights adding depth to the trees. The monochromatic color scheme enhances the organic feel of the scene, depicting a woodland environment.

artworks.title: The Triumphal Arch of Maximilian
artworks.medium: 42 woodcuts and 2 etchings on laid paper assembled to form one image
artworks.dimensions: overall size: 354 x 298.5 cm (139 3/8 x 117 1/2 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of David P. Tunick and Elizabeth S. Tunick, in honor of the appointment of Andrew Robison as Andrew W. Mellon Senior Curator
artworks.description: A stepped, ornately decorated structure made up of forty-four individual woodcuts and etchings printed with black ink on ivory-white paper fills this vertical composition. The structure has a tall central tower flanked by two shorter towers on each side. All three have an arched opening at the bottom. The outer towers are then flanked by three columns. Almost every inch of the structure is densely covered with architectural ornaments, coats of arms, Gothic text, and panels showing scenes with people in interiors or huge crowds in landscapes. Some scenes show soldiers engaged in battle, groups of kings and clergy, or individual men. Architectural ornament includes mythical creatures, gargoyles, saints, kings, and cherubs. The arched openings are tall and narrow, and have checkered floors. Words in elaborate Latin script appear inside the top of each of the three arches. Two ringed-tailed creatures resembling monkeys prowl outside the central arch. Two shallow steps lead down from the structure to five panels that line the base of the composition. Those five panels are filled with Gothic text. The date, "1515," appears at the base of the outermost column to each side.

artworks.title: The Abduction of Helen of Troy
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with brown wash on gray laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Emile Wolf, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a nautical scene with classical elements and mythological themes. In the foreground, there is a large, ornate ship with intricate carvings, including a lion's head at the prow. Several figures are depicted on the ship, one of whom is a standing woman with raised hands, and another figure holding a spear. On the right side, a figure in a helmet with a plume stands on a smaller vessel or a part of a ship, gesturing towards the larger ship. The background features billowing clouds and vague architectural forms. The drawing is rendered in a detailed style typical of classical and mythological illustration.

artworks.title: The Arrival of Aesculapius in Rome
artworks.medium: pen and black ink and gray wash over graphite on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Emile Wolf, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a dragon and several people in a mythological scene. The detailed drawing shows a bustling ancient port with a ship docked on the left side. Various figures are depicted on the ship, some adjusting sails. In the foreground, there are figures interacting. To the right, a domed building with elaborate architectural features is shown as people gather around an altar with rising smoke. In the foreground, a small dragon faces the gathered individuals. The style of the drawing is classical, emphasizing intricate detail and dynamic composition.

artworks.title: Repairing a Dome
artworks.medium: black chalk on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Emile Wolf, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image shows an architectural space with a ground-level perspective. The horizon is suggested through the structure's curvature and elements. The image uses a drawing technique with textured lines and shading. The color palette is monochromatic in shades of brown and black. Wooden scaffolding structures are on the left, leading to a large archway in the distance. There are arches and openings in the space creating a play of light and shadow, emphasizing the grandeur of the environment.

artworks.title: Christ among the Doctors
artworks.medium: red and black chalks on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Emile Wolf, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
